query:
SELECT id, client_name, value, status, type, description, due_date, paid_date
FROM bpo_charges
WHERE client_name LIKE '%MHAMED%'
  AND description LIKE '%Pix recebido%'
  AND status IN ('received', 'confirmed', 'receivedInCash')
ORDER BY due_date DESC
LIMIT 5
